sections.heading: What is trending: “ai cyberattack”
paragraphs: “ai cyberattack” appeared on Google Trends' Trending Now list for NG (snapshot taken 2026-11-28T10:26:38+00:00 UTC). Google reports at least 100 searches for this term — that figure is a lower bound published in the official Trends feed, not an exact count.

sections.heading: What's behind the spike — the coverage
paragraphs: The Trends feed associates this search spike with 3 news stories from Bundesamt für Cybersicherheit BACS, Microsoft, National Cyber Security Centre. The headlines, exactly as published:
list: “Familiar weaknesses, exploited faster: defending against agentic cyber attacks” — National Cyber Security Centre
“Cyberattacks involving AI agents: First confirmed cases in Switzerland” — Bundesamt für Cybersicherheit BACS

sections.heading: Timeline
paragraphs: The trend entry was published to the Google Trends feed at Fri, 27 Nov 2026 23:30:00 -0800. Our snapshot was taken at 2026-11-28T10:26:38+00:00 UTC and this briefing was assembled at 2026-11-28T10:27:13+00:00 UTC.

sections.heading: How to read these numbers
paragraphs: Google Trends reports approximate search volume as a lower bound (for example “20K+”). Actual volume can be significantly higher. Trending status reflects acceleration in searches, not the absolute size of a topic. For the full story behind the spike, read the cited coverage below — this briefing intentionally adds no speculation beyond the sourced facts.
